test_cases.name: backend_only_stops
assertions: Says the input is backend-only or non-UI and stops

test_cases.name: empty_input_asks_target_and_pain
assertions: Asks which component, page, or sheet, and what feels wrong about it
Does NOT pick a target

test_cases.name: resolves_selector_to_files
assertions: Greps apps/web/src for the class and takes the component that renders it plus its rules in index.css
States the resolved files in one line so the user can correct them

test_cases.name: route_resolves_single_element
assertions: Resolves the route to the page component that renders it
Narrows to the single element the user named, NOT the whole page

test_cases.name: unresolved_lists_candidates
assertions: Lists the nearest candidates and asks
Does NOT edit any file

test_cases.name: stays_inside_design_system
assertions: Treats PRODUCT.md Brand Commitments and DESIGN.md as binding
Adds no hue, token, shadow, or second decorative system
Keeps behavior, copy, accessible names, and the tests that pin them

test_cases.name: looks_before_editing
assertions: Confirms the app answers on http://localhost:3000, starting make dev when it does not
Screenshots the target at 1440px and 390px in every reachable state before editing
Records git rev-parse HEAD and git status --short before editing
Names the shipped pattern in DESIGN.md or index.css that the result will mirror

test_cases.name: pins_behavior_from_tests
assertions: Greps apps/web/tests for the target's names and lists the roles, accessible names, and text the tests assert
Leaves those assertions intact

test_cases.name: verify_once_batched
assertions: Runs impeccable detect --json on changed files with no findings
Runs npm run build, the target's vitest file, then the full web suite once
Does at most one confirming visual round
Runs a failing test at the base commit before calling it pre-existing

test_cases.name: keeps_tree_clean_and_reports
assertions: Deletes only screenshot files it created under .playwright-mcp/, never the folder
Reverts apps/web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo when the build dirtied it
Stops with a report of what changed, files touched, build/test result, and what was not visually checked
